name: Narrato
tagline: Narrato is an AI content creation and workflow platform for content teams. It combines an AI writer with content briefs, SEO tools, plagiarism checks, and a project management workflow. Content marketers and agencies use it to manage the entire content lifecycle from brief to published post.
